0022600039.text: This Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game sends the Utah Jazz on the road to the Houston Rockets, with Utah (1-11, 0-5 on the road, 0-10 in its last ten) sitting 15th in the West and Houston (9-3, 6-1 at home, 7-3 in its last ten) on a two-game winning streak and 2nd in the Southwest. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture) and Trey Alexander (ankle sprain), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost the series 1-3, including a 140-106 defeat in Houston on April 3, 2026.
